sources.title: Mach4 CNC Controller Mill Programming Guide (Newfangled Solutions / Artsoft USA)
Mach4 CNC Controller Mill Programming Guide

program_open.value: No required start code described. Manual recommends a safe-start block first. A % after the final M30 is recommended to guarantee the last EOB (anything after program end is not read).

program_close.value: M30 = end and rewind (defaults G54/G17/G90 etc. reset); M02 = end without rewind. Follow the end block with an EOB, e.g. a trailing %.
program_close.where: Ch.1 Format p9-10; Ch.5 M02 p82, M30 p84

comment.note: UNKNOWN: the programming guide does not describe comment syntax (memory says parentheses and ';' work, unverified).

line_numbers.value: N = sequence number, used for organisation and go-to; optional. No maximum stated.

block_end.value: EOB = carriage return; required at end of every block including the last.

safe_start.value: Recommended safe-start block: G00 G90 G17 G54 G40 G49 G80 (repeat it at every tool change). Units G21 mm / G20 inch (programming units only), G94 feed per minute. Several G codes per block allowed; last one of a modal group wins; one M code per block.
safe_start.where: Ch.1 Format p9-10; G20/G21 p35; G94 p54

tool_change.value: T<n> M6 (T on same block or earlier); with a preload-arm setting, T on the M6 line is the next tool.

tool_change_behaviour.value: M06 starts a tool change; whether T on the M6 line means 'tool to use' or 'next tool' is a control parameter. The guide mentions a tool change macro (G53 moves 'in a tool change macro'); the manual/ATC pause behaviour itself is not described in this guide.
tool_change_behaviour.note: Manual-pause behaviour UNKNOWN from this source.

tool_length_comp.value: G43 H<n> (positive), G44 negative, G49 cancel; motion only if axes in the block. Examples use G43 H1 Z.5 after T1 M6.
tool_length_comp.where: G43/G44, G49 p42; Ch.3 examples p58

spindle.value: S rpm (G97) with M03 CW / M04 CCW / M05 stop; M03 without S uses last speed.

work_offset.value: G54..G59 plus G54.1 P1..P248 (248 extra). Legacy G59 P7.. = G54.1 P1.. still accepted.

arc_format.value: G02/G03 with I J K or R (R>0 sweep <180, R<0 >180). Arc-centre mode G90.1 absolute / G91.1 incremental, also set in configuration, independent of G90/G91.

feed.value: F units/min in G94 (inch or mm per G20/G21); G95 per rev.

decimal_point.value: Decimal point not required: X1 = X1.0 in Mach (recommended to write it anyway). Leading zeros optional.

retract_home.value: G28 via intermediate point (G0 G91 G28 Z0 goes straight up); manual calls G53 Z0 (non-modal machine coordinates) the safer way home; G30 2nd-4th reference.

coolant.value: M07 mist, M08 flood, M09 all off. No through-spindle code listed.

dwell.value: G04 P (or X) = milliseconds when written without a decimal point, seconds with a decimal point (G4 P5000 = G4 P5. = 5 s); U without point = ms. A # variable in P implies a decimal point (seconds). Must be the only G code in its block.

drill_G81.value: G81 X Y Z R L F

dwell_drill_G82.value: G82 X Y Z R P L F (P dwell)

peck_G83.value: G83 X Y Z Q R L F; Q peck (positive); full retract to R each peck, retract clearance parameter 5115 (default 0.25 mm metric).

chipbreak_G73.value: G73 X Y Z Q R L F; Q peck; retract amount parameter 5114 (default 0.6 mm metric).

rigid_tap_G84.value: G84 X Y Z R L F = floating tap, spindle must run forward first; F is feed per minute = rpm x pitch in G94, or simply the pitch in G95 (needs spindle feedback). Rigid tap: G84.2 (RH) / G84.3 (LH) X Y Z R P L F J (J = retract spindle speed, P dwell ms). Overrides and feed hold disabled during the cycle.

bore_G85.value: G85 X Y Z R L F (feed in, feed out; boring/reaming).

return_level.value: G98 initial point return; G99 R point return.

cycle_cancel.value: G80, recommended alone on its own line.

cycle_dwell_units.value: Canned-cycle P is in milliseconds per the cycle word list (and G84.2 P 'in milliseconds'); but the G82 example writes P.2 (decimal -> seconds by the G04 rule).
cycle_dwell_units.note: Write P with a decimal point in seconds or integer ms; mixed signals in the manual.

native_language.value: G-code (Fanuc-like, 'closer to the industry standard') is the language; custom macro B style # variables / G65; Lua for M-code macros is outside this guide. No mode switch.

notes: Mach4 is closer to Fanuc than Mach3: G54.1 P1-248, dwell ms-without-point, G84.2/G84.3 rigid tap. Comment syntax not in the open programming guide.
